table_metadata.table_title: Table 4. Schedule of Activities for Early Termination, Unscheduled Visits, and Post-Treatment Follow-Up Period
table_metadata.table_purpose: Early termination visit (ETV), unscheduled visit (V997) and post-treatment follow-up visits (V801, V802)
table_metadata.notes: Independent schedule with its own visit columns (ETV, V997, V801, V802) referenced by Tables 1-3 for early termination and unscheduled visits; typed main_soa (alternative: track for the follow-up phase, see review item D11). L=1; data columns positions 2-5. Page 46 contributes only the Randomization and Dosing header and a mark-free Dosing row whose comment states no dosing in this period.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Visit identifiers: ETV (early termination visit), V997 (unscheduled visit), V801 and V802 (post-treatment follow-up visits); property_type visit.
Week timing: dash for ETV and V997 (event-driven); V801 at 58 or ETV + 8 weeks after last dose, V802 at 66 or ETV + 16 weeks after last dose; property_type week.
Study day row; all cells show a dash (no fixed study day). property_type study_day by label.
Visit window: dash for ETV and V997, ±7 days for V801 and V802; property_type window.

Shaded header-band row; no visit is marked, and the Comment cell reads 'No fasting in this period'. A visit attribute rather than a timing level; typed modality for consistency across the corpus (the taxonomy has no property type for a visit attribute); does not distinguish columns, so hierarchical_level null.

annotations.annotation_text: V802 is only for randomized participants who were positive for anti-HBc at screening. All other participants will have their final visit at V801 or ETV.
V997: Additional study procedures can be performed at the discretion of the investigator.

The intervals between ETV and the post-treatment follow-up visit(s) should be adequate to ensure that V801 occurs at least 8 weeks since last dose and V802 (if applicable) occurs at least 16 weeks since last dose.
For AESIs, additional data are collected (Section 8.3.6).
Blood pressure, body temperature, and pulse rate. Vital signs should be measured after participant has been sitting for at least 5 minutes.
Fasting is not required for the lipid panel at ETV.

Perform only for women of childbearing potential and women with a history of tubal ligation. At dosing visits which have pregnancy testing, the pregnancy test result must be confirmed to be negative prior to dosing. Pregnancy testing may be performed more frequently than designated on the SoA if local laws or regulations require more frequent testing.
Only for participants who are positive for anti-HBc at screening.
Collect samples before dosing, if dosing is scheduled. Collect additional samples at specified times relative to onset of hypersensitivity events.
Blood sample for DNA pharmacogenetics can be obtained any time at or after V2.
Recommended at ETV based on judgment of the investigator and after discussion with the sponsor’s medical monitor. If not performed at ETV, this will not be considered a protocol deviation.
Recommended at ETV based on judgment of the investigator and after discussion with the sponsor’s medical monitor.
No dosing at ETV, V997, or post-treatment follow-up visits.
V997: Vital signs collection is optional.
Instructions for collection are provided in the lab manual. Flexible sigmoidoscopy is recommended, except for protocol-specified reasons when a colonoscopy should be performed.
If not performed at ETV, this will not be considered a protocol deviation.
